cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 ether/sulfonate chassis - defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3), Decyl Glucoside (4), Coco-Glucoside (5); no prominent reinforcing strong anionic (C3, C4, C1).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Refatters (Glyceryl Oleate 11) and lipids are counter-signals only; three buffers, no reinforcing anionic.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met - prominent payload lipids Dicaprylyl Ether (10) and Hydrogenated Castor Oil (14) take the place of the early silicone, with cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9), pearlizing Glycol Distearate (13) and humectant Glycerin (12); Glyceryl Oleate (11) adds a refatting route. Parfum is declared at 18, so all of these are prominent (E3).
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: No silicone; the lipids are a light emollient ether and a structuring hydrogenated oil; prominence rests on an unusually late Parfum.
